d:
Expedition Unknown takes Josh Gates deep into Egypt on a search for the lost resting places of two legendary rulers, Nefertiti and Cleopatra. From the grand Karnak Temple to the Valley of the Queens and the Valley of the Kings, Josh explores ancient burial sites, meets archaeologists and investigates clues that could lead to Nefertiti's missing tomb. Could one of Egypt's greatest royal secrets still be hidden in plain sight?
Watch Expedition Unknown, Season 4, Episode 11, on Discovery Channel India.
